Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I am sure I ought to be satisfied, considering too the [sum for the copyrights](../others.html#160) in March, but just one question.

Have I ever been paid for [the last volume of Cameos](../books.html#124), I do not think I have, as it came out just after last years settlement I have always had £100 for each volume.
I am afraid I have been very stupid about both French histories and I am still waiting for [Mr Freeman](../persons.html#523)’s decision.[^2] I have never found that sheet of the Primer, which I thought I had put away.

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: CMY was writing two books for Macmillan entitled History of France. [One](../books.html#353) was to appear in the \'Historical Primers\' series edited by J. R.

Green.

The [other](../books.html#99), in the \'Historical Course for Schools\' series, was being ruthlessly criticised by the series editor, E. A.

Freeman, which was holding up its appearance.
